transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because I keep beating myself up at work. I don’t feel like I’m really senior material, and I worry I fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I actually can.
How long have you been feeling this way about your work performance—did it start recently after some specific event, or has this been a pattern for you for months or years?
It really became noticeable about a month ago, after they asked me to cover the senior analyst duties. Since then, it’s felt more up and down.
Do you notice yourself worrying excessively about other things in your life too—like family, health, or finances—or does the worry mainly center on your work performance?
I’m not really sure. I’ve mostly noticed it around work and this senior role.
Over this past month, have you noticed a persistent low or sad mood, or a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
Yeah. Most days lately I’ve had this heavy, low feeling. It’s like I’m going through work and home with the color turned down.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep—like trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual—over this past month?
Yeah. Some nights I wake up way too early thinking about client tickets and can’t get back to sleep. Other times I sleep enough hours, but I still wake up feeling worn out.
Over this past month, have you found yourself feeling worthless or excessively guilty about things, beyond just feeling anxious about your work performance?
Yeah. I keep beating myself up, thinking I’m not really senior material—that I fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I actually can.

Outside of work, have you also lost interest or enjoyment in things you used to like doing—like hobbies, time with family or friends—or does the low mood mostly come up when you're thinking about your job?
Yeah, it’s outside of work too. I usually look forward to grilling on the weekend, going fishing, or putting on a record, but lately I just leave the stuff sitting there. I don’t really care much.
Over this past month, have you had any thoughts of death, or thoughts that you'd be better off not being here?
I haven’t made any plan to hurt myself, but... yeah, sometimes I think it might be easier if I just didn’t wake up one morning.
Over this past month, have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight—eating much more or less than usual?
Yeah, my appetite’s been off. I’ll just grab a few bites, or skip supper altogether. My belt’s a little looser too, and I’m not trying to lose weight.
